classification.difficultyReason: Combine exact tangent ratios in two right triangles using the total base length, then rationalise a binomial surd denominator.

content.prompt: For the diagram shown, find the exact value of $x$.

spec.description: Triangle ADC with A, B and C collinear, perpendicular altitude DB, base AC dimension arrow and both given base angles. Ordinary source blue strokes become house black.
spec.mathematics: DB=x cm; AC=100 cm; angle DAB=45 degrees; angle DCB=30 degrees; DB perpendicular to AC.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens appear in the question diagram.

answer.short:
$x=50(\sqrt{3}-1)$.

Use the exact tangent ratios in the two right triangles and add their base lengths.
answer.worked:
In $\triangle ABD$ and $\triangle CBD$:

$$\begin{align*}\tan45^\circ&=\frac{x}{AB}\\AB&=x\\\tan30^\circ&=\frac{x}{BC}\\BC&=\sqrt{3}x\end{align*}$$

Since $AB+BC=AC$:

$$\begin{align*}x+\sqrt{3}x&=100\\x&=\frac{100}{1+\sqrt{3}}\\x&=\frac{100(\sqrt{3}-1)}{(1+\sqrt{3})(\sqrt{3}-1)}\\x&=50(\sqrt{3}-1)\end{align*}$$

Thus $DB=50(\sqrt{3}-1)\text{ cm}$.
